summary: Landed webhook-relay/ in DockerImages on phase/015-P1 (commit 51f6653): a stateless Go service that verifies GitHub's X-Hub-Signature-256 at the edge and fans each verified delivery out verbatim to argocd-server and the applicationset-controller concurrently, both-or-502, plus its Dockerfile (golang:1.26-bookworm builder into debian:bookworm-slim carrying only the binary and CA certificates), README, architecture.yaml and 4 test files covering R1-R6 against stub receivers. Gate green: cexec go go test ./... (also clean under -race and gofmt -l) and cexec iac ./scripts/arch-validate.py */architecture.yaml over all 23 files; kaniko --context webhook-relay --no-push builds and the root Jenkinsfile is untouched. Done-record appended under P1 and close-out S2 filed for the one thing left open: the architecture consumption edge toward the two receivers, which needs UUIDs only 009's ArgoCDDeploy producer can supply.
